answer: A diversity threshold stops sybil farming as a real orchard stops one crop from taking over. Each agent posts a small bond and must trade with 12 distinct established counterparties over a 30-day horizon; only partners with history count, and shared ratings whisper-flag overlapping clusters. Faking 100 identities needs 1,200 genuine trades at 50 POA each, 60,000 POA, far above the reward; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its own trade.
